apps.name: spoti.pw
apps.subtitle: Spotify, in glass.
apps.localizedDescription:
A no-jailbreak Theos tweak that rebuilds Spotify for iOS in Liquid Glass, injected into your own decrypted Spotify IPA. Built and tested on Spotify 9.1.78; the app installs over the real Spotify and keeps its bundle id.

Built for iOS 26, where the redesigned UI is Liquid Glass. On iOS 16.1 to 25 the mod runs its native look instead: Spotify's own screens with everything else it adds on them. The Live Activity needs iOS 17.

This is an unofficial build of the mod published for AltStore and SideStore. It is not affiliated with Spotify, and no Spotify IPA is distributed with it. Support the mod's author at ko-fi.com/darkksh.
